notes: Ethereum mainnet SIMD Launchpad preset. Resolve $poolManager to 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, $token to the freshly deployed SIMDTEST and $factory to the launch factory that calls PoolManager.initialize directly (beforeInitialize accepts only that sender, once). Mine hook flags 0x28cc. The factory must initialize, seed the 80% pool allocation with IMD, and perform the 10% dead-address / 10% swarm allocation; seeding must happen either directly from the factory address or inside the initialize transaction, because beforeAddLiquidity rejects every other liquidity addition while the anti-snipe fee is nonzero (blocks B..B+9) so just-in-time positions cannot capture donations. The factory derives the actual opening price from launch economics. Hook fees stay in IMD: 0.5% to 0x3dd5f73dd1a4e62630fad3909673f130ad429985 plus a 30%-to-0% ten-block anti-snipe amount donated via PoolManager.donate, which accrues as claimable fee growth to the in-range launch position (its owner must be able to collect); if a swap leaves no in-range liquidity the anti-snipe amount goes to the treasury instead. The launchpad handles the 1% creator fee externally; this hook never duplicates it.
